findings.detail: The three code fixes described in the ticket comments (Gerrit changes 1567 and 1570) are NOT present in the repository. (1) infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh:51-53 still uses repo-local git config (not --global) — the comment at line 51 explicitly says 'repo-local (not --global)' and lines 52-53 use `git -C "$DIR" config user.email/user.name` without --global. The primary defect fix (global identity) is absent. (2) infra/compose/docker-compose.yml has no bind-mount for rebar-bot-signing-key and no REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY in the review-bot service environment section — the key mount fix is absent. (3) infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:34-36 installs only `git curl ca-certificates` with no openssh-client — the ssh-keygen fix is absent. The ticket's end-to-end confirmation (39 events with author_sig=True) is an operator attestation, but this is a codebase-verifiable criterion.

findings.criterion: Bug 'One environment writes every event unsigned and identity-less (author=Unknown, 8880 events, ongoing)' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
findings.detail: The three code fixes required to resolve the bug are not present in the repository. (1) The global git identity fix in reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh is absent — the script still sets only repo-local identity. (2) The key bind-mount in docker-compose.yml is absent — no rebar-bot-signing-key mount or REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY environment override in the review-bot service. (3) The openssh-client installation in Dockerfile.reviewbot is absent — the image still only installs git, curl, and ca-certificates. From the current codebase, the three defects identified in the ticket would still reproduce: author_id would be null (no global identity), the key would be unreadable in the container (no mount), and ssh-keygen would be unavailable (no openssh-client). The bug is not resolved in the codebase.
